# Square Peg Pizzeria

> Wood-fired pizza made from scratch daily, with 10 locations in Connecticut and Delray Beach, Florida. Online ordering for pickup and delivery, catering, a wood-fired food truck, Tuesday night fundraisers, and a rewards app.

## Menu (Italian-American restaurant + wood-fired pizza)
- Pizza: Neo-Neapolitan rounds (Wood-fired, 12″ (6 slices) or 18″ (8 slices), red or white.); Detroit-style (Thick, crispy-edged 10×14″ pan pizza (6 slices). At every location except Bolton.); Gluten-free (12″ gluten-free crust on any round pie. Vegan cheese on any pizza.)
- Pasta: Chicken Parmesan, Pasta alla Vodka, Pasta Bolognese, Shrimp Scampi, Spaghetti & Meatballs, The Bella Parmigiana
- Parm sandwiches & Italian subs: Chicken Parm, Meatball Parm, Eggplant & Ham Parm, Italian Combo, The Hot Honey Eggplant
- Starters & wings: House-made pork meatballs, Calamari, Honey bruschetta, Fried mozzarella & garlic bread, Wood-fired wings
- Salads: Caesar, House, Chef, market greens & more
- Kids' meals: Kids pasta, spaghetti & meatballs, pasta alla vodka, Chicken fingers & mac and cheese
- Beer, wine & cocktails: Cocktails, Beer, Wine
- Desserts: New York-style cheesecake, Gelato sandwiches & Italian sorbet, Fried dough, brownies & warm cookies
- Full overview: https://squarepegpizzeria.com/our-menu/. Live menus and prices: each location's order link above.
